What the brief says: Deposits are applied once, deducted only with approval and version, and disputable.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel): the booking advance is a payment toward the booking price. The security or damage deposit is separate refundable money held against approved damage, extras or deductions. They stay separate in balances, financial events, refunds, reporting and accounting. ||| Built: the advance stays on the booking (advance_paise, paid_paise). The security deposit is its own append-only record (security_deposit_entries, server/src/securityDeposit.ts) with its own balance, routes, audit and ledger accounts (security_deposits_held liability, deposit_deductions income). It is OFF until securityDepositEnabled is switched on. Reconcile checks the deposit separately. No screen exists yet on the website or mobile app. The older retention-dispute workflow still runs on the booking advance and is kept (LEGACY, not removed).
Needs: Tests REL-BIZ-UD01-001..003 pass in the automated run. Device and screen verification NOT_RUN.

What the brief says: BOOK-006 hierarchical resource conflict; BOOK-007 multi-resource atomic allocation.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel): a whole-ground booking blocks every net, pitch or resource configured as included in it, and the reverse holds too. A genuinely independent resource stays available only if explicitly configured non-conflicting. Guppi never decides this. Conflicts behave identically across all booking channels. ||| Built: ground_links (server/src/groundLinks.ts) is the configuration; linkedBusy() is consulted in takeSlots (hold.ts, the final guard), the options search, availability, the late-payment check and the staff block check. Staff configure it with PUT /api/staff/grounds/:id/links. One level only. Block rows on a parent do not block children (only bookings do). No screen yet.
Needs: Tests REL-BIZ-UD02-001..003 pass in the automated run. Device and screen verification NOT_RUN.

What the brief says: Rescheduling must be atomic and follow the same rules as booking.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel): customer rescheduling is blocked at exactly 24 hours or less before the start; at most 2 successfully completed customer moves (failed or abandoned attempts do not count); the existing booking stays protected until the replacement is held; a dearer replacement means the customer pays the difference; a cheaper one uses the approved Daji credit or refund settlement, never a silent refund; the original time and resource are never overwritten without history; staff override needs permission, a reason and audit and does not use the customer's moves. Customer rescheduling stays OFF until its screens and device tests pass. The settings (24 hours, 2 moves) are approved values. ||| Built in server/src/reschedule.ts: rescheduleCutoffHours=24, rescheduleMaxMoves=2, rescheduleCheaperTreatment=credit. customerRescheduleEnabled stays OFF by default. The dearer difference is a balance collected through the existing balance payment path (desk or recorded payment), there is no online top-up screen. Honest limits: the replacement is taken before the old time is released inside one transaction, there is no separate visible temporary hold; the bookings row is updated while the original details live in the append-only booking_reschedules history and audit.
Needs: Tests REL-BIZ-UD03-001..011 pass in the automated run. Customer rescheduling is NOT complete: no customer screens, no device tests.

What the brief says: Parity must be shown on desktop web, iPad web, iOS and Android.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: Only API-level parity can run here (four client identities). Device columns are NOT_RUN.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: Go-live gate stays closed until devices are run.

What the brief says: Test and live must be separated and fail closed.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: A live server will not start unless APP_ENV=live, real provider keys, FILE_SCANNER=clamav with a reachable ClamAV, and DEMO_MODE off. The construction suite likewise refuses NODE_ENV=production without FILE_SCANNER=clamav. Operators must set these before the first start of the patched release.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: The server exits with a FATAL message instead of running unsafe.

Assumption made (nothing structural was: Keep the current (old) Daji. Daji 2.0 is a separate foundation and is not merged. Moving to its database-level rules is a later project (P1-09).

Release switches now SHIP OFF in a fresh database: guppiAssistEnabled=false and customerRescheduleEnabled=false (retentionDisputesEnabled stays on). Test harnesses switch them on explicitly; REL-LANG-042 proves the shipped defaults.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: If left ON before the screens are run on devices, the Guppi booking endpoint is reachable by signed-in customers under the normal rules.

What the brief says: Guppi must resolve words like "Sunday", "this Sunday", "next Sunday" and "another Sunday" in every language.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: Proposed: a bare weekday or "this/aa" = the first such day after today (said on that same weekday: asked, today or +7; "this/aa" on that day = today). "next/upcoming/aavta/agle" = the first after today (a week on if today is that day). "another/bijo" = a week after the day already being discussed (asked if none). The exact date is always shown before any hold. DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel, his words): "YES, approved. Relative dates such as Sunday, next Sunday and equivalent Gujarati/Hindi/Romanized expressions are approved. Resolve them using the applicable customer/local date context. If the intended date is genuinely ambiguous, ask the customer rather than guessing." Tested: REL-LANG-008, -013, -014, -017, -034.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: Customers may mean a different Sunday; every case is shown as an exact date before a hold, so no wrong booking is made silently.

What the brief says: "ground koi pan chale" (any ground will do).
Assumption made (nothing structural was: Proposed: any ground of the SAME KIND (a match ground, not practice nets), the preferred ground first; offers still come from Daji and each shows its ground. DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel, his words): "YES. If no ground is specified, eligible grounds may be searched. If a ground is specified, preserve it. If it is unavailable, Guppi may offer other grounds as alternatives, but the customer must select the alternative. Do not silently substitute grounds." Tested: REL-LANG-020 (the named ground is kept and no other ground is offered until the customer says any ground will do; then other grounds are tagged as another ground).
Effect if the assumption is wrong: If any bookable place should count, nets could be offered for a match request.

Assumption made (nothing structural was: DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel, his words): "Guppi must understand equivalent natural-language booking requests without requiring exact phrases, including supported script, Romanized language, spelling variations and mixed-language input." Tested: REL-LANG-001..006, -011, -014, -025.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: None; a rule for Guppi, not a change to the booking system.

What the brief says: A conversation must not make the customer repeat themselves.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel, his words): "Guppi must preserve confirmed conversation context across turns. A customer should not have to repeat previously supplied booking information, and changing one field must not silently change other confirmed fields." Tested: REL-LANG-007, -012, -015, -016, -017.

What the brief says: Guppi must not guess where a guess could book the wrong thing.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel, his words): "Guppi should clarify only genuine ambiguity that could materially change the requested booking. Do not unnecessarily force exact dates, formal wording or repetition when the intended request can be safely resolved." Tested: REL-LANG-008, -013, -019, -029.
